title: Design System: 旅のしおり · 關東秋季紅葉巡航

display.purpose: Cover title only, vertical-rl, with red plate offset.

numeral.purpose: Day numbers (66px) and the cover countdown (50px).

body-small.purpose: Notes, stub details, plan dates, box headings.

label.purpose: Tracked section headings followed by a rule.

stub-time.purpose: Time in a ticket stub's tear-off.

materials.name: grain
materials.value: SVG fractalNoise (baseFrequency .85) tinted ink, opacity .075, mix-blend-mode multiply
materials.purpose: Paper tooth over every sheet and the cover.

materials.name: halftone
materials.value: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(42,74,155,.22) 1.1px, transparent 1.4px) 7px 7px, masked to fade upward, 64px
materials.purpose: Halftone gutter at the foot of the cover.

materials.name: misregistration
materials.value: red copy of the glyphs translate(3px,2.5px) (numerals 2.5px,2px), multiply, opacity .8–.85

materials.name: rough
materials.purpose: Pressed-ink edge on stamps, hanko and checkboxes.

materials.name: double-rule
materials.purpose: Foot of every page band; head of meal notes, plan, dish lists, asides.

materials.name: cut
materials.purpose: 切り取り線 between slips, the lodging line, perforations.

materials.name: memo-ruling
materials.purpose: Ruled lines of the memo page.

motion.name: ink-press
motion.purpose: 到著章 stamp landing. The signature motion.

motion.name: check-pop
motion.value: opacity 120ms ease; transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1.2); scale .5→1.12, rotate −12→−6deg
motion.purpose: Red check mark on a checklist tick.

motion.name: colour-state
motion.purpose: Link and cover-button colour changes on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all transitions and animations off; smooth scrolling off

components.name: Cover Button
components.description: Bordered white-stock action on the cover (翻開目錄, 行前準備).
components.css: :host{--ink:#2a4a9b;--ink-rule:rgba(42,74,155,.38);--red:#c42c36;--red-ink:#a0202c;--red-plate:#e3443f;--paper:#fff;--desk:#2a4a9b;--lemon:#f4df6a;--mizu:#bedcee;--wakakusa:#cae2a6;--momo:#f5c4c0;--fuji:#d6caea;--font:'Huninn Shiori','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;--heavy:'Zen Maru Heavy','Huninn Shiori',sans-serif} .ds-cover-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:46px;padding:0 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:4px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:400 15px/1.8 var(--font);text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .15s ease,color .15s ease}.ds-cover-btn:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}.ds-cover-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed var(--red-ink);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Today Button
components.description: Solid red cover action shown only during the trip.
components.css: :host{--ink:#2a4a9b;--ink-rule:rgba(42,74,155,.38);--red:#c42c36;--red-ink:#a0202c;--red-plate:#e3443f;--paper:#fff;--desk:#2a4a9b;--lemon:#f4df6a;--mizu:#bedcee;--wakakusa:#cae2a6;--momo:#f5c4c0;--fuji:#d6caea;--font:'Huninn Shiori','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;--heavy:'Zen Maru Heavy','Huninn Shiori',sans-serif} .ds-cover-btn-today{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:46px;padding:0 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--red-ink);border-radius:4px;background:var(--red-ink);color:#fff;font:400 15px/1.8 var(--font);text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .15s ease}.ds-cover-btn-today:hover{background:#861a24}.ds-cover-btn-today:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed var(--red-ink);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Index Tabs
components.description: Sticky strip of stock-coloured tabs on the blue desk; active rises with a red top edge, today is solid red. No animation.
components.html: 封面日程2日目3日目5日目
components.css: :host{--ink:#2a4a9b;--ink-rule:rgba(42,74,155,.38);--red:#c42c36;--red-ink:#a0202c;--red-plate:#e3443f;--paper:#fff;--desk:#2a4a9b;--lemon:#f4df6a;--mizu:#bedcee;--wakakusa:#cae2a6;--momo:#f5c4c0;--fuji:#d6caea;--font:'Huninn Shiori','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;--heavy:'Zen Maru Heavy','Huninn Shiori',sans-serif} .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:8px 10px 0;background:var(--desk)}.ds-tab{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1px;min-height:40px;padding:11px 12px 8px;border-radius:7px 7px 0 0;border-top:3px solid transparent;background:var(--stock);color:var(--ink);font:400 14px/1 var(--font);text-decoration:none;transform:translateY(5px)}.ds-tab small{font-size:11.5px}.ds-tab:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed var(--red-ink);outline-offset:3px}.ds-on{transform:none;border-top-color:var(--red-ink)}.ds-today{background:var(--red-ink);color:#fff}

components.name: Ticket Stub
components.description: A day's hard commitment: time in the tear-off, subject and detail, and a hanko.
components.html: 10:30関内店取車トヨタレンタカー · GR Yaris · 預約 98119828100予約済
components.css: :host{--ink:#2a4a9b;--ink-rule:rgba(42,74,155,.38);--red:#c42c36;--red-ink:#a0202c;--red-plate:#e3443f;--paper:#fff;--desk:#2a4a9b;--lemon:#f4df6a;--mizu:#bedcee;--wakakusa:#cae2a6;--momo:#f5c4c0;--fuji:#d6caea;--font:'Huninn Shiori','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;--heavy:'Zen Maru Heavy','Huninn Shiori',sans-serif} .ds-stub{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:78px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;min-height:64px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:6px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font)}.ds-stub::before,.ds-stub::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:71px;width:14px;height:14px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper)}.ds-stub::before{top:-8px;clip-path:inset(50% 0 0 0)}.ds-stub::after{bottom:-8px;clip-path:inset(0 0 50% 0)}.ds-stub-t{align-self:stretch;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-right:1.5px dashed var(--ink);font-size:23px;line-height:1;color:var(--red-ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-stub-b{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:10px 10px 10px 14px;min-width:0}.ds-stub-w{font-size:16px;line-height:1.4}.ds-stub-d{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}.ds-hanko{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:48px;height:48px;margin-right:10px;border:2px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%;color:var(--red-ink);font-size:12px;line-height:1;transform:rotate(-12deg)}

components.name: Stock Chip

components.name: Checklist Item
components.description: Hand-ruled checkbox ticked with a red check that pops in; text strikes through in red.
components.css: :host{--ink:#2a4a9b;--ink-rule:rgba(42,74,155,.38);--red:#c42c36;--red-ink:#a0202c;--red-plate:#e3443f;--paper:#fff;--desk:#2a4a9b;--lemon:#f4df6a;--mizu:#bedcee;--wakakusa:#cae2a6;--momo:#f5c4c0;--fuji:#d6caea;--font:'Huninn Shiori','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;--heavy:'Zen Maru Heavy','Huninn Shiori',sans-serif} .ds-ck{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;align-items:start;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-rule);color:var(--ink);font:400 15px/1.75 var(--font);cursor:pointer}.ds-ck input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-ck-box{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px}.ds-ck-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:2px}.ds-ck-box svg{width:24px;height:24px;color:var(--red);opacity:0;transform:scale(.5) rotate(-12deg);transition:opacity .12s ease,transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1.2)}.ds-ck input:checked+.ds-ck-box svg{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.12) rotate(-6deg)}.ds-ck input:focus-visible+.ds-ck-box{outline:2px dashed var(--red-ink);outline-offset:3px}.ds-ck input:checked~.ds-ck-t{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--red);text-decoration-thickness:1.5px}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Two-Ink Shiori"**

The itinerary is the hand-made 旅のしおり two friends staple together before a trip, printed on a risograph with exactly two drums. Federal Blue prints every word and every rule; riso red is reserved for what cannot slip. Each page is a sheet of stock: white paper for reading, coloured 色上質紙 (レモン, 水色, 若草, 桃, 藤) for the cover, page bands, index tabs and chips. The sheets sit on a desk of the same blue ink, so the booklet reads as an object laid down rather than an app shell.

Density is a printed booklet's, not a dashboard's: one page per day, generous 1.8 body leading, sections divided by rules rather than boxes. Depth is paper only. There is a faint multiply grain over every sheet, a halftone gutter at the foot of the cover, a deliberate red-plate misregistration behind the heavy numerals, and a displacement filter that roughens stamps and hand-ruled checkboxes. Optional material is folded away into 付録 slips; the red ticket stubs carry the day's hard commitments.

Confirmed rejections: cream grounds, terracotta, gradients used as fills, glass, card shadows, and the timeline-of-cards app shell.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks only (blue, red) on white or coloured stock; everything else is paper.
Hierarchy by size and rule weight, never by grey tint.
Rules are the structure: 1.5px solid, 1px dashed cuts, 4px double rules, 2px dotted leaders.
Heavy rounded numerals with a red misregistration shadow for the title, day numbers and countdown.
Red belongs to hard commitments: booking times, deadlines, hanko, stamps, today.
One authored motion: the ink press.

rules.name: The Two Drums Rule
rules.body: Text and rules print in blue or red and nothing else. White text appears only knocked out of a solid red or blue fill (today's tab and button, the hovered cover button, the out-of-booklet tabs on the desk).

rules.name: The Red Is a Promise Rule
rules.body: Red marks a booking time, a deadline, a hanko, a stamp or today. A suggestion, a tip or a highlight never gets red; the lemon marker underline is for emphasis.

rules.name: The Red Plate Rule
rules.body: `red` is for large graphic marks; any red text under display size uses `red-ink`, which holds 5.58:1 on white.

rules.name: The Size Not Grey Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is never tinted grey or faded. It is smaller, and that is all: `.dim` shrinks to 0.92em in full ink.

rules.name: The One Heavy Rule
rules.body: The heavy face exists only for the title, the countdown and day numerals. Its subset cannot set anything else, and nothing else should want it.

rules.name: The Paper Only Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow`, no blur, no gradient fills. If something needs to stand forward, give it a different stock or a heavier rule.

dos: Do print every word and rule in `ink` or `red-ink`; use `red` only for large marks (stamps, plates, check marks).
Do set a page's stock once with a `stock-*` class and let the band, tab, chips and dots inherit `--stock`.
Do put each day's bookings and deadlines in ticket stubs with a hanko, and fold everything optional into 付録 slips.
Do close every page band with a 4px double rule, and use 1px dashed cuts for slips and tear-off lines.
Do build hierarchy from size alone (15.5px body, 13.5px small, 14px tracked labels).
Do keep tap targets at 44–50px and body text at AA contrast on its stock.
Do re-subset Huninn Shiori with `tools/trip-font.py` after changing any text.
Do mark today with the red double rule, the 今天 hanko and the red tab together.
donts: Don't add box shadows, blur, glass or gradient fills; depth is stock, rule and grain.
Don't use cream or terracotta grounds.
Don't tint secondary text grey or reduce its opacity.
Don't give suggestions, tips or highlights red.
Don't fill today's band red; the band keeps its stock.
Don't animate tabs, page changes or reveals; the only authored motion is the ink press and the check-mark pop.
Don't set anything but the title, countdown and day numerals in Zen Maru Heavy.
Don't add a side rail or marker column that costs phone width.
Don't load CSS, fonts or icons from a CDN; the booklet must render fully styled offline.
